reviewNotes: The festival identity, unchanged setup, all first-year fishing-contest event paths, spouse conversations, and first villagers were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover event commands, character voice, fishing terminology, canonical terms, natural Romanian, and exact controls; both found no remaining objective issue.

Penny_spouse.source: Are you entering the fishing contest this year, @? My mom's pretty serious about winning.
Penny_spouse.translation: Te înscrii la concursul de pescuit anul acesta, @? Mama este foarte hotărâtă să câștige.

Haley_spouse.source: Brr... my hands are freezing from making this snowman.$l
Haley_spouse.translation: Brr... mi-au înghețat mâinile făcând omul acesta de zăpadă.$l

Sebastian_spouse.source: Don't worry about me, I never get cold...
Sebastian_spouse.translation: Nu-ți face griji pentru mine, mie nu mi-e frig niciodată...

Sam_spouse.source: Aren't you cold? Are you sure you don't want my jacket?
Sam_spouse.translation: Nu ți-e frig? Sigur nu vrei geaca mea?

Alex_spouse.source: I'll be rooting for you in the fishing competition.
Alex_spouse.translation: O să-ți țin pumnii la concursul de pescuit.

Harvey_spouse.source: I'm dreaming of our warm fire back home...$l
Harvey_spouse.translation: Visez la focul cald de acasă...$l

Elliott_spouse.source: I know you'll beat me in the fishing competition, but I don't mind. I'm just here for the fun of it.$h
Elliott_spouse.translation: Știu că mă vei învinge la concursul de pescuit, dar nu mă deranjează. Sunt aici doar ca să mă distrez.$h

Abigail.source: What do you think of my snow-goon?
Abigail.translation: Ce părere ai despre golanul meu de zăpadă?

Robin.source: I'm sorry, but carving ice parapets requires my undivided attention!
Robin.translation: Îmi pare rău, dar sculptarea parapetelor de gheață îmi cere toată atenția!

Demetrius.source: You know what? I probably should've worn a jacket.
Demetrius.translation: Știi ceva? Probabil că ar fi trebuit să-mi iau o geacă.

Maru.source: I'm not very creative when it comes to snowmen.$s
Maru.translation: Nu sunt prea creativă când vine vorba de oameni de zăpadă.$s

Sebastian.source: Cold? Nah, I never get cold.
Sebastian.translation: Frig? Nu, mie nu-mi este frig niciodată.

Pierre.source: This snow is so cold I can't feel my fingers anymore...$s
Pierre.translation: Zăpada asta este atât de rece, încât nu-mi mai simt degetele...$s

Shane.source: If it was up to me, I'd probably have a pizza festival at the saloon, instead...
Shane.translation: Dacă ar fi după mine, probabil aș organiza în schimb un festival al pizzei la tavernă...

Caroline.source: How's winter coming along for you, @?$h

Linus.source: Igloo-building's an art I picked up from the tundra dwellers who live beyond the frozen sea.#$e#That was many years ago.$h#$e#An Igloo makes a nice home, but it's easier to just stay in my tent year-round.
Linus.translation: Construirea igluurilor este o artă pe care am învățat-o de la locuitorii tundrei de dincolo de marea înghețată.#$e#Asta a fost acum mulți ani.$h#$e#Un iglu este o casă plăcută, dar e mai simplu să rămân în cortul meu tot anul.

Alex.source: Snowmen are okay, I guess. But mostly I'm looking forward to the spring.
Alex.translation: Oamenii de zăpadă sunt în regulă, cred. Dar cel mai mult aștept Primăvara.
